init.title: Smoothing
init.description: The detector sends a reading every second and most of the change is sensor jitter. Smoothing averages the jitter away and records a new value only when the level really moves; a sudden real change (for example breathing on the sensor) is shown immediately.

data_description.filter_enabled: Turn off to record every raw reading.
data_description.filter_tau: Longer is calmer and records less; slow changes show up later. 60 s is a good default.
